title: Hobbitt Hamper
text: Hobbitt Hamper. It's a foot wide and less than 1.5 feet in height - Super cute tho - We got the Bicycle one - I think we are going to use it as a waste basket.

product_metadata.title: Danica Studio Entwine Market Tote, Small
features: Made from thick, sturdy cotton with webbed cotton handles
Flexible and foldable round hamper for portability, collapses when empty
Measures 13 inches in diameter, 16 inches tall
Ideal for laundry, pillows and toys- or even as a tote for the beach or sporting events
description: This canvas hamper from Danica Studio is perfect for every room! Toys, pillows, blankets, laundry and more fit just right, and webbed cotton handles make carrying easy. These hampers could even be used for a sports or beach tote: fill with fluffy swim towels or sports gear and go! The hampers are constructed to be flexible and foldable for comfort and portability. When empty, they collapse for convenient storage. Made from sturdy, thick, 100% cotton, this hamper measures 13 inches in diameter and 16 inches tall. Simple care: machine wash.
